promptBlocks.text:
FORMAT: 30s / 9:16 vertical / luxury menswear-automotive ASMR film / clean precise cuts, each shot built around one tactile sound event, calm confident pacing
STYLE: Cinematic editorial realism matching @Image 2: soft overcast London light with warm boutique glow, muted stone and charcoal palette against silver paint, ARRI look with fine grain, shallow depth of field on detail shots, polished high-end commercial grade, one visual identity, no style mixing. All signage softly out of focus in every shot.
REFERENCES:
@Image 1 defines the hero's identity ONLY: preserve this exact man's face, features, skin tone, curly dark brown hair and light beard in every shot, black square-framed wayfarer sunglasses on at all times. Do NOT inherit any clothing, objects or background from @Image 1. Wardrobe redesigned in refined American heritage luxury style: navy unstructured double-breasted blazer over a crisp white oxford shirt, top button open, a cream cable-knit sweater draped over the shoulders and loosely tied, tailored beige pleated trousers, dark brown suede loafers, a slim silver dress watch. This exact outfit is identical in every shot.
@Image 2 defines the environment and the car: a corner luxury heritage menswear boutique with a deep navy awning, tall dark-framed windows glowing warm with mannequins, pale limestone facade, granite sett pavement, and a silver modern flagship sports coupe parked at the curb: wide rear haunches, retractable rear wing, black multi-spoke wheels over yellow brake calipers, twin exhausts, dark glass roof. Match this exact storefront, street, light and car. Exactly ONE car, street otherwise empty.
VIDEO PROMPT:
[Shot 1 — 0–2.5s, hook] Interior-facing close-up on the boutique's brass door handle: a hand grips it, the latch releases with a crisp metallic click, and the tall glass door swings open into the grey street light. End state: door open, hero stepping through.
[Shot 2 — 2.5–5s] Cut. Low cinematic angle from the pavement: the hero steps out of the doorway under the navy awning, adjusts the blazer lapel with one small tug, sunglasses catching the soft sky. Slow push-in as he pauses, seeing the car. End state: chin lifting toward the coupe.
[Shot 3 — 5–7.5s] Cut. Tracking at knee height behind him: unhurried confident steps across the granite setts toward the car, loafers striking stone with clean sharp footfalls, trouser fabric swaying. End state: arriving at the front fender.
[Shot 4 — 7.5–10s] Cut. Macro: his fingertips land on the silver fender and glide slowly along the beltline toward the door, reflections of the limestone facade sliding across the paint. End state: fingers stopping above the door handle.
[Shot 5 — 10–12s] Cut. Extreme macro on the flush door handle: it deploys outward with a precise electric whirr and a soft click; his fingers curl under it. End state: handle gripped.
[Shot 6 — 12–14.5s] Cut. The door swings open with a smooth hinge glide; he lowers into the black leather sport seat, leather flexing with a rich slow creak, and pulls the door shut with one deep thunk. Sunglasses on. End state: seated, settled.
[Shot 7 — 14.5–16.5s] Cut. Interior macro: the seatbelt draws across the chest and the buckle seats with a bright metallic click; his hand comes to rest on the leather-wrapped wheel. End state: hands set.
[Shot 8 — 16.5–19s] Cut. Macro on the start control: his finger presses it, the flat-six ignites with a deep muscular bark, then settles into a smooth turbocharged idle pulsing gently through the cabin. End state: idle steady.
[Shot 9 — 19–21.5s] Cut. Rear exterior macro on the engine cover: the retractable wing rises slowly on its supports with a fine servo whirr until it locks. End state: wing fully deployed.
[Shot 10 — 21.5–24s] Cut. Ground-level macro by the twin exhausts: the idle breathes, one restrained rev sends a low rounded pressure pulse toward the lens, faint heat shimmer. End state: burble settling.
[Shot 11 — 24–27s] Cut. Wide from across the street: the boutique glowing behind, the silver coupe eases off the curb and rolls past camera left to right, tires pattering softly over the granite setts. End state: car crossing frame.
[Final shot — 27–30s] Cut. Low rear three-quarter static: the coupe recedes down the narrow stone street, wing silhouetted, exhaust echoing softly off the facades and fading. Hold the final frame 0.8s as the street falls quiet.
AUDIO: No music, no score anywhere. Pure diegetic ASMR sound design only, close-mic, crystal clean, intimate. <Foreground events in order: crisp brass latch click and door swing, awning fabric shifting in the breeze, clean loafer footfalls on granite setts, slow fingertip glide on paint, electric handle whirr and click, smooth hinge glide, rich leather creak, one deep door thunk, seatbelt draw and bright buckle click, start-control press, deep flat-six ignition bark settling to a pulsing turbo idle, fine servo whirr of the rising wing, one restrained exhaust rev, soft tire patter on setts, fading exhaust echo between the buildings.> <Continuous ambience: quiet London street, distant city hum, faint pigeons, light breeze.> No dialogue, no voices, no laughter, no vocal sounds, no voiceover, no subtitles.
CONSISTENCY: One single hero throughout, exactly the same man as @Image 1: identical face, curly hair, beard and black wayfarer sunglasses in every shot; sunglasses never removed. Identical outfit in every shot, sweater staying draped over the shoulders. Exactly one silver coupe, same details, same parking spot. Same street, same overcast light; screen direction left to right for the walk and the drive.
NEGATIVE PROMPT: no music, no soundtrack, no vocal sounds, no dialogue, no removed sunglasses, no altered identity, no outfit changes, no second car, no other people, no pedestrians, no traffic, no legible signage or plate text, no on-screen text or logos, no drone shots, no slow motion, no style mixing, no CGI look, no warped hands, no distorted car.

references.label: @Image 1 — Identity only. Face, curly dark hair, light beard, black wayfarer sunglasses. Clothing, table and background are explicitly discarded by the prompt.
@Image 2 — Environment and car. Navy awning, limestone facade, granite setts, silver flagship coupe with yellow calipers. Signage is pushed out of focus by the STYLE line.

tutorialHtml:
DENIZ AKKABAK · SEEDANCE 2.5 TUTORIAL · @DENIZ.AKKABAK

MADE IN INVIDEO · invideo.io/i/DENIZ-ig

The Curbside Ritual

Thirty seconds of menswear-to-engine ASMR, cut around twelve tactile sounds — with a real face locked into every shot.

A TUTORIAL BY DENIZ AKKABAK · @DENIZ.AKKABAK

PIPELINE SEEDANCE 2.5 IN INVIDEO · FORMAT 30S · 9:16 · GENRE LUXURY ASMR FILM

Most AI car films fail for the same reason: they try to be trailers. Big music, drone sweeps, slow motion — and the model, given nothing concrete to hold onto, drifts into generic CGI gloss. This one goes the other way. There is no music at all. Every shot is built around a single sound you could reproduce with your own hands — a brass latch, a suede footfall on granite, a flush door handle whirring out of the bodywork, one deep thunk as the door closes. When a shot has exactly one job, the model stops guessing and starts staging.

The second trick is the identity split. The photo of the hero is a breakfast snapshot in a grey T-shirt; the location photo is a silver coupe at a boutique curb. The prompt tells Seedance 2.5 to take only the face from the first and only the world from the second, then rebuilds the wardrobe from scratch in text. The result is a stranger in his own film: same curls, same beard, same wayfarers, dressed for a street he has never stood on.

STEP 01 · SEEDANCE 2.5 — INVIDEO

Two References, One Prompt, Thirty Seconds

Everything happens in a single generation. Attach the two images in the order below — the prompt refers to them as @Image 1 and @Image 2, so the order is the whole contract. Set the model to Seedance 2.5, the aspect ratio to 9:16 and the duration to 30 seconds, then paste the prompt exactly as it appears in the box.

REFERENCE INPUTS — ATTACH IN THIS ORDER

SETTINGS

  1. 01

    Model

    Seedance 2.5, selected from the invideo model picker. The prompt is written for its shot-list syntax — bracketed shots with timecodes and an explicit end state each.

  2. 02

    Format & length

    9:16 vertical, 30 seconds. The FORMAT line repeats both inside the prompt so the model reads the frame and the runtime as part of the brief, not just as a menu setting.

OUTPUT

STEP 02 — THE REASONING

Anatomy — Why This Prompt Holds Together

Seven decisions carry the film. Each one is anchored to a line you can find in the prompt above.

  1. 01

    The contract

    FORMAT declares "each shot built around one tactile sound event, calm confident pacing" before a single shot is described. It tells the model what kind of film this is, so the twelve shots that follow are read as a rhythm rather than a list.

  2. 02

    Identity by subtraction

    @Image 1 "defines the hero's identity ONLY" and the prompt then says "Do NOT inherit any clothing, objects or background". The face is locked, everything around it is released — which is what lets a breakfast photo become a menswear campaign.

  3. 03

    Wardrobe written, not shown

    Blazer, oxford, cable-knit over the shoulders, pleated trousers, suede loafers, silver watch — every garment is named in text, then sealed with "This exact outfit is identical in every shot." The model has no reference photo to drift from, only a spec to obey.

  4. 04

    Environment as a checklist

    @Image 2 is unpacked into nouns: navy awning, dark-framed windows, limestone facade, granite setts, wide haunches, retractable wing, yellow calipers, twin exhausts. Naming what is in the photo is how you tell the model which details are non-negotiable.

  5. 05

    End states

    Every shot closes with "End state: …" — door open, handle gripped, idle steady, wing fully deployed. The end state of one shot is the physical starting condition of the next, so the cuts read as continuity instead of twelve unrelated clips.

  6. 06

    Sound as structure

    AUDIO lists the foreground events "in order", and that order is the edit. The bracketed ambience layer sits underneath it. "No music, no score anywhere" appears twice, because a model given the word luxury will reach for a soundtrack unless told, firmly, not to.

  7. 07

    The insurance

    The NEGATIVE PROMPT closes the exits the film would most likely take: no drone shots, no slow motion, no pedestrians, no second car, no removed sunglasses, no legible signage. Each one is a specific failure that was possible given the brief, not a generic list.

THE RESULT — SEEDANCE 2.5

Output — The Curbside Ritual, 30s

When you generate your own, check it against the prompt rather than against your taste: sunglasses on in every shot, sweater still draped after the seat creak, exactly one car, screen direction left to right on the walk and the drive, and — the easiest one to miss — no music underneath the exhaust echo. If all five hold, the skeleton worked.

THE SOUND IS THE SHOT

Give the model one thing to listen to, and it will know exactly what to show.

Swap the boutique for a bakery, the coupe for a vintage bicycle, the loafers for climbing boots — the skeleton carries any object you can touch. Twelve shots, twelve sounds, one identity lock, one environment lock, no music. Everything else is set dressing.

WRITTEN, DIRECTED & PROMPTED BY DENIZ AKKABAK · @DENIZ.AKKABAK
